replay_receipt.scope: raw3D postprocessing only; no model, confidence unused by production Pose3DConstraints, native frame order including explicit flush preserved

interpretation: Independent postprocessing ablations on identical already-inferred raw arrays and native frame order. No GT or accuracy claim. Full/prior include angular stages; bone-only removes angular stages; angle-only removes bone stage. Neither speed norms nor nonlinear stage effects are additive. Prior/session target updates and per-frame bone scale are separate causes.
